title: LP2-54–55: skip selected F runes in ciphertext feedback
question: Does the skip interruption rule produce an unusually high maximum periodic IoC across the declared 64 masks and periods 2–30?
summary: Period 13 with no interruptions is the unique maximum, IoC=332/6992. 557/999 conditional shuffles reach at least that maximum; corrected p=0.558. No evidence of excess under this model.

scope.representation: Archived rune indices, headings retained, punctuation removed; concatenate LP2-54 then LP2-55 without resetting state.
scope.procedure: P_i=(C_i-previous_ciphertext) mod 29; update previous_ciphertext=C_i. Unselected F behaves normally. Score the compact output after selected Fs are removed. Selected F is emitted unchanged, excluded from scored output, and leaves previous non-interruption ciphertext unchanged. Sum ordered equal-symbol pairs within residue columns divided by sum ordered pairs within those columns. Maximize across all masks and periods; exact ratio comparisons. Keep all six F positions fixed. Independently permute the remaining non-F ciphertext multiset, freshly copied each trial. Repeat the complete mask-and-period search for each trial. This conditions on F positions, rune counts and length; it is not an English-text model.
scope.parameters: Initial ciphertext state 0; modulus 29; all 64 subsets of six F positions; all periods 2–30 inclusive; 1,856 configurations per input. 999 shuffles; random.Random seed 330154; upper tail with ties and (count+1)/1000. Threshold 0.05. Bonferroni correction for the two planned reset/skip variants.
scope.exclusions: Plaintext autokey; Other interruption symbols; Arbitrary primers or keys; Heading removal; Page-local state resets; Other period ranges; Language-score or plaintext claims; Significance of original exploratory search.

finding: Period 13 is the largest observed score, but the winning configuration selects no interruptions. Its pooled IoC is about 0.04748. The complete mask-and-period search reaches at least this value in 557 of 999 shuffled inputs (corrected p=0.558); the peak is not unusual under this comparison.
limitations: New explicit implementation, not a rerun of unavailable source scripts. The null fixes F locations and rune counts while destroying other order. This tests one chosen statistic and scope; it does not rule out autokey, interruptions or period 13 in general. Both modes have the same observed winner and are not independent confirmations. Human review pending.
next_steps: Keep changed interruption symbols, primers, heading rules, page resets or period ranges as separately declared variants. Establish language-score controls before treating transformed output as plaintext.
